sections.title: Physical properties of organic compounds
sections.intro: The table shows the boiling points of four organic compounds.
sections.introAf: Die tabel toon die kookpunte van vier organiese verbindings.

questions.q: Define the term boiling point.
points: The temperature at which the vapour pressure of a liquid equals the atmospheric (external) pressure
questions.qAf: Definieer die term kookpunt.
pointsAf: Die temperatuur waarby die dampdruk van ’n vloeistof gelyk is aan die atmosferiese (eksterne) druk

questions.q: Why were compounds with similar molar masses chosen for this comparison?
points: So that the strength of the London (dispersion) forces is about the same, making it a fair test
questions.qAf: Waarom is verbindings met soortgelyke molêre massas vir hierdie vergelyking gekies?
pointsAf: Sodat die sterkte van die London-(dispersie)kragte ongeveer dieselfde is, wat dit ’n regverdige toets maak

questions.q: Explain the difference between the boiling points of propanal and propan-1-ol. Refer to the type and strength of the intermolecular forces.
points: Propanal: dipole-dipole forces (and London forces) between molecules
Hydrogen bonds are stronger than dipole-dipole forces
More energy is needed to overcome the forces in propan-1-ol, so its boiling point is higher
questions.qAf: Verduidelik die verskil tussen die kookpunte van propanal en propan-1-ol. Verwys na die tipe en sterkte van die intermolekulêre kragte.
pointsAf: Meer energie is nodig om die kragte in propan-1-ol te oorkom, dus is sy kookpunt hoër

questions.q: Which compound in the table has the highest vapour pressure at room temperature? Give a reason.
points: it has the weakest intermolecular forces (only London forces)
questions.qAf: Watter verbinding in die tabel het die hoogste dampdruk by kamertemperatuur? Gee ’n rede.
pointsAf: dit het die swakste intermolekulêre kragte (slegs London-kragte)

questions.q: Explain why ethanoic acid has a higher boiling point than propan-1-ol.
points: Ethanoic acid molecules form two hydrogen bonds between pairs of molecules (dimers) ; propan-1-ol forms one, so more energy is needed for ethanoic acid
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom etanoësuur ’n hoër kookpunt as propan-1-ol het.
pointsAf: Etanoësuurmolekules vorm twee waterstofbindings tussen pare molekules (dimere) ; propan-1-ol vorm een, dus is meer energie vir etanoësuur nodig

questions.q: Which has the higher boiling point: pentane or 2,2-dimethylpropane? Give a reason.
points: Pentane, because its straight chain has a larger contact area, so its London forces are stronger
questions.qAf: Watter een het die hoër kookpunt: pentaan of 2,2-dimetielpropaan? Gee ’n rede.
pointsAf: Pentaan, want sy reguit ketting het ’n groter kontakoppervlak, dus is sy London-kragte sterker

sections.title: Organic reactions
sections.intro:
Study the reactions below.
Reaction 1: propene + HBr → 2-bromopropane
Reaction 2: 2-bromopropane + dilute NaOH (mild heat) → propan-2-ol
Reaction 3: propan-2-ol + concentrated H₂SO₄ (heat) → propene + water
Reaction 4: 2-bromopropane + concentrated KOH in ethanol (strong heat) → propene
sections.introAf:
Bestudeer die reaksies hieronder.
Reaksie 1: propeen + HBr → 2-broompropaan
Reaksie 2: 2-broompropaan + verdunde NaOH (matige hitte) → propan-2-ol
Reaksie 3: propan-2-ol + gekonsentreerde H₂SO₄ (hitte) → propeen + water
Reaksie 4: 2-broompropaan + gekonsentreerde KOH in etanol (sterk hitte) → propeen

points: structural formula of propene + HBr → structural formula of 2-bromopropane, with Br on the middle carbon
questions.qAf: Gebruik struktuurformules om ’n gebalanseerde vergelyking vir Reaksie 1 te skryf.
pointsAf: struktuurformule van propeen + HBr → struktuurformule van 2-broompropaan, met Br op die middelste koolstof

questions.q: How do the reaction conditions for Reaction 4 differ from those for Reaction 2? Give TWO differences.
points: concentrated base dissolved in ethanol (not dilute and in water)
questions.qAf: Hoe verskil die reaksietoestande vir Reaksie 4 van dié vir Reaksie 2? Gee TWEE verskille.
pointsAf: gekonsentreerde basis opgelos in etanol (nie verdun en in water nie)

questions.qAf: Is propan-2-ol ’n primêre, sekondêre of tersiêre alkohol? Gee ’n rede.
pointsAf: die C-atoom wat aan die –OH-groep gebind is, is aan twee ander C-atome gebind

questions.q: Propene reacts with hydrogen to form propane. Name a catalyst for this reaction.
questions.qAf: Propeen reageer met waterstof om propaan te vorm. Noem ’n katalisator vir hierdie reaksie.

questions.q: Write a balanced equation, using molecular formulae, for the complete combustion of propane.
questions.qAf: Skryf ’n gebalanseerde vergelyking, met molekulêre formules, vir die volledige verbranding van propaan.

questions.q: Propene is the monomer of a common plastic. Name the polymer and the type of polymerisation.

sections.title: Rate of reaction
sections.intro:
Learners react 5 g of calcium carbonate with 100 cm³ of hydrochloric acid of concentration 1,5 mol·dm⁻³ at 25 °C:
CaCO₃(s) + 2HCl(aq) → CaCl₂(aq) + H₂O(ℓ) + CO₂(g)
In experiment I they use lumps of CaCO₃ and in experiment II they use the same mass of CaCO₃ powder.
sections.introAf:
Leerders laat 5 g kalsiumkarbonaat met 100 cm³ soutsuur met ’n konsentrasie van 1,5 mol·dm⁻³ by 25 °C reageer:
CaCO₃(s) + 2HCl(aq) → CaCl₂(aq) + H₂O(ℓ) + CO₂(g)
In eksperiment I gebruik hulle klonte CaCO₃ en in eksperiment II gebruik hulle dieselfde massa CaCO₃-poeier.

questions.q: Define reaction rate.
points: The change in concentration (or amount) of reactants or products per unit time
questions.qAf: Definieer reaksietempo.
pointsAf: Die verandering in konsentrasie (of hoeveelheid) van reaktanse of produkte per eenheid tyd

questions.q: Write down the independent variable in this investigation.
points: state of division (surface area) of the CaCO₃
questions.qAf: Skryf die onafhanklike veranderlike in hierdie ondersoek neer.
pointsAf: toestand van verdeeldheid (oppervlakte) van die CaCO₃

questions.q: Use the collision theory to explain why the reaction in experiment II is faster.
points: The powder has a larger surface area exposed to the acid
More particles can collide at the same time, so there are more collisions per unit time
so more effective collisions per unit time
questions.qAf: Gebruik die botsingsteorie om te verduidelik waarom die reaksie in eksperiment II vinniger is.
pointsAf: Die poeier het ’n groter oppervlakte wat aan die suur blootgestel is
Meer deeltjies kan terselfdertyd bots, dus is daar meer botsings per eenheid tyd
dus meer effektiewe botsings per eenheid tyd

questions.q: Show by calculation that the hydrochloric acid is in excess.
points: 0,05 mol CaCO₃ needs only 0,1 mol HCl, so HCl is in excess
questions.qAf: Toon deur berekening aan dat die soutsuur in oormaat is.
pointsAf: 0,05 mol CaCO₃ benodig slegs 0,1 mol HCl, dus is HCl in oormaat

questions.q: Calculate the mass of CO₂ produced when all the CaCO₃ has reacted.
questions.qAf: Bereken die massa CO₂ wat gevorm word wanneer al die CaCO₃ gereageer het.

questions.q: Experiment II is complete after 2 minutes. Calculate the average rate of CO₂ production in mol·s⁻¹.
questions.qAf: Eksperiment II is na 2 minute voltooi. Bereken die gemiddelde tempo van CO₂-produksie in mol·s⁻¹.

questions.q: Experiment II is repeated at 40 °C. Use the Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution to explain why the rate increases.
points: At the higher temperature more particles have kinetic energy equal to or greater than the activation energy
so there are more effective collisions per unit time
questions.qAf: Eksperiment II word by 40 °C herhaal. Gebruik die Maxwell-Boltzmann-verspreiding om te verduidelik waarom die tempo toeneem.
pointsAf: By die hoër temperatuur het meer deeltjies kinetiese energie gelyk aan of groter as die aktiveringsenergie
dus is daar meer effektiewe botsings per eenheid tyd

sections.title: Chemical equilibrium
sections.intro:
4 mol SO₂(g) and 3 mol O₂(g) are sealed in a 2 dm³ container at temperature T. The reaction reaches equilibrium:
2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2SO₃(g) ΔH < 0
At equilibrium the container holds 2,4 mol SO₃(g).
sections.introAf:
4 mol SO₂(g) en 3 mol O₂(g) word in ’n houer van 2 dm³ by temperatuur T verseël. Die reaksie bereik ewewig:
2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2SO₃(g) ΔH < 0
By ewewig bevat die houer 2,4 mol SO₃(g).

questions.q: State Le Chatelier's principle.
points: When the equilibrium in a closed system is disturbed , the system re-instates a new equilibrium by favouring the reaction that opposes the disturbance
questions.qAf: Stel Le Chatelier se beginsel.
pointsAf: Wanneer die ewewig in ’n geslote stelsel versteur word , stel die stelsel ’n nuwe ewewig in deur die reaksie te bevoordeel wat die versteuring teenwerk

questions.q: Calculate the equilibrium constant K_(c) at temperature T.
points:
Initial (mol): SO₂ 4; O₂ 3; SO₃ 0
Change (mol): SO₂ −2,4; O₂ −1,2; SO₃ +2,4
questions.qAf: Bereken die ewewigskonstante K_(c) by temperatuur T.
pointsAf:
Aanvanklik (mol): SO₂ 4; O₂ 3; SO₃ 0
Verandering (mol): SO₂ −2,4; O₂ −1,2; SO₃ +2,4

questions.q: The temperature is increased. Will the value of K_(c) INCREASE, DECREASE or STAY THE SAME? Explain.
points: The forward reaction is exothermic, so an increase in temperature favours the endothermic reverse reaction
questions.qAf: Die temperatuur word verhoog. Sal die waarde van K_(c) TOENEEM, AFNEEM of DIESELFDE BLY? Verduidelik.
pointsAf: Die voorwaartse reaksie is eksotermies, dus bevoordeel ’n toename in temperatuur die endotermiese terugwaartse reaksie

questions.q: The volume of the container is decreased at constant temperature. How will this affect the yield of SO₃? Explain.
points: The forward reaction is favoured, because it forms fewer moles of gas (3 mol → 2 mol)
questions.qAf: Die volume van die houer word by konstante temperatuur verklein. Hoe sal dit die opbrengs van SO₃ beïnvloed? Verduidelik.
pointsAf: Die voorwaartse reaksie word bevoordeel, want dit vorm minder mol gas (3 mol → 2 mol)

questions.q: A catalyst is added to the system at equilibrium. How does this affect the yield of SO₃? Explain.
points: No effect ; a catalyst increases the rates of the forward and the reverse reactions equally
questions.qAf: ’n Katalisator word by die stelsel in ewewig gevoeg. Hoe beïnvloed dit die opbrengs van SO₃? Verduidelik.
pointsAf: Geen effek nie ; ’n katalisator verhoog die tempo van die voorwaartse en die terugwaartse reaksies ewe veel

sections.intro: A galvanic cell is set up under standard conditions with a nickel electrode in a Ni²⁺(aq) solution and a silver electrode in a Ag⁺(aq) solution. The half-cells are joined by a salt bridge and a voltmeter.

sections.title: Electrolytic cells
sections.intro: Chlorine and sodium hydroxide are made in industry by the electrolysis of concentrated sodium chloride solution (brine) in a membrane cell.
sections.introAf: Chloor en natriumhidroksied word in die nywerheid berei deur die elektrolise van gekonsentreerde natriumchloriedoplossing (pekel) in ’n membraansel.

questions.q: Define electrolysis.
points: The chemical process in which electrical energy is converted into chemical energy (a current drives a non-spontaneous reaction)
questions.qAf: Definieer elektrolise.
pointsAf: Die chemiese proses waarin elektriese energie in chemiese energie omgeskakel word (’n stroom dryf ’n nie-spontane reaksie)

questions.q: Write down the half-reaction at the anode.
questions.qAf: Skryf die halfreaksie by die anode neer.

questions.q: Name the gas that forms at the cathode.
questions.qAf: Noem die gas wat by die katode vorm.

questions.q: Explain the function of the membrane.
points: It allows only Na⁺ ions to pass through to the cathode side , which keeps the chlorine away from the sodium hydroxide (and the hydrogen)
questions.qAf: Verduidelik die funksie van die membraan.
pointsAf: Dit laat slegs Na⁺-ione deur na die katodekant , wat die chloor weghou van die natriumhidroksied (en die waterstof)

questions.q: Calculate the percentage of nitrogen by mass in this fertiliser.
questions.qAf: Bereken die persentasie stikstof volgens massa in hierdie kunsmis.

questions.q: Explain how the overuse of fertilisers can harm rivers and dams.
points: Fertiliser washes into the water and causes eutrophication (rapid growth of algae)
When the algae die and decompose, oxygen in the water is used up and fish and other organisms die
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe die oormatige gebruik van kunsmis riviere en damme kan benadeel.
pointsAf: Kunsmis spoel in die water en veroorsaak eutrofikasie (vinnige groei van alge)
Wanneer die alge doodgaan en ontbind, word die suurstof in die water opgebruik en vis en ander organismes gaan dood
